_comment: The copy manifest (docs/INTEGRATION.md §2): the list of core-layer files a release offers a host. 'always' travels with every take; groups are the menu --take selects from. `gateline init` records the taken subset in the host's framework-lock.json. What travels is content only — role specs, contracts, templates. The framework's own tooling is not vendored: it runs from the checkout the lock pins (INTEGRATION.md §3, the two-channel model). Until non-SDLC content exists upstream, --take all and --take sdlc resolve to the same set.
